requirements.rationale: Duy designed and ran a 24-cell controlled experiment: four retrieval-encoder substrates, each evaluated frozen and fine-tuned, crossed with three frozen vision-language decoders. The four retrieval encoders are Mammo-CLIP (mammography-native), OpenCLIP (generic web images), a biomedical-figure encoder, and BioCLIP…

The held-out majority-class retrieval floor is P@1 = 0.487; fine-tuning the mammography-native encoder produced the only arm of twenty-four to clear it, moving from 0.513 frozen to 0.585 fine-tuned. requirements.requirement: Operating LLM serving infrastructure under load
requirements.rationale: Duy has built LLM and retrieval systems and has shipped an AI feature inside a production website, but he has not operated LLM serving infrastructure under load — no throughput target he owns, no capacity plan, no incident he has been paged for. What he does have is the operational discipline around it: a safety lock…
